description: Energy System Uncertainty Catalog is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Rohith Bala Krishnan (Institute of Renewable energy Technology (Hochschule Nordhausen)). Energy System Uncertainty Catalog A structured catalog of uncertainties for energy-system modelling, covering parametric, structural, and temporal uncertainties across renewable energy, heat, bioenergy, Power-to-X/hydrogen, storage, imports, grid infrastructure, and demand sectors. The catalog is designed to support uncertainty analysis, sensitivity analysis, scenario development, and model robustness assessment in integrated energy-system models. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
